ref.description: The finding's reference exactly as given in the input, for example F1.
ref.title: Ref

adjusted_severity.description: Your severity for this finding given its context and evidence. It may differ from the scanner's severity.

confidence.description: How sure you are of this judgment.

false_positive_likelihood.description: How likely it is that the finding is not a real issue.

priority.description: How soon to act: P1 now, P2 within days, P3 plan it, P4 when convenient.

rationale.description: Why, in one or two sentences, based on the evidence.
rationale.title: Rationale

exploitability.description: How an attacker could use this issue, or an empty string if they cannot.
exploitability.title: Exploitability

remediation_steps.description: Concrete steps that fix the issue, most important first.
remediation_steps.title: Remediation Steps

description: Your judgments of the findings in the input.

findings.description: One judgment per finding in the input.
findings.title: Findings

title: TriageReply
